name: OSM Edit MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to search, validate, and edit OpenStreetMap data through natural language commands and built-in safety protections. It supports discovery of nearby amenities, geographic data exploration, and secure map editing via OAuth authentication.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI assistants to search, validate, and edit OpenStreetMap data through natural language commands and built-in safety protections. It supports discovery of nearby amenities, geographic data exploration, and secure map editing via OAuth authentication.

API_KEY.description: Security API key for remote deployment and API access authentication.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., INFO, DEBUG, WARNING, ERROR).

OSM_USE_DEV_API.description: Use the OpenStreetMap development API (true) or production API (false).

OSM_DEV_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2 Client ID for the OpenStreetMap development server, required for write operations.

OSM_DEV_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2 Client Secret for the OpenStreetMap development server, required for write operations.

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: API rate limiting configuration defining how many requests per minute are allowed.
